endorsements.name: Jay Lv
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-8927
endorsements.description: A buffer overflow exists in the Brotli library versions prior to 1.0.8 where an attacker controlling the input length of a "one-shot" decompression request to a script can trigger a crash, which happens when copying over chunks of data larger than 2 GiB. It is recommended to update your Brotli library to 1.0.8 or later. If one cannot update, we recommend to use the "streaming" API as opposed to the "one-shot" API, and impose chunk size limits.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)
